# mplchart

Classic technical analysis stock charts in Python, built on matplotlib.

This site is rendered HTML for humans. The markdown sources below are
better suited for LLM consumption.

## API reference

- [mplchart.chart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/chart.md): charting main module
- [mplchart.primitives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/primitives.md): mplchart drawing primitives
- [mplchart.indicators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/indicators.md): Technical analysis indicators — pandas pipeline only
- [mplchart.expressions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/expressions.md): Polars expression factories
- [mplchart.styles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/styles.md): Chart styling — the runtime `Styler` and its spec forms
- [index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/reference/index.md): Reference overview and conventions

## Guides

- [backends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/furechan/mplchart/main/docs/backends.md): pandas and polars data pipelines
